headline: Review of flight discrepancy reports, the new RNP 29Z approach procedure, and upcoming flight schedules.
summary: The meeting covers airline use of a new RNP 29Z approach procedure that overlays the Harbor Visual Approach. It also covers passenger data, flight schedules, and flight discrepancy reports from June through October 2026.
items: Opening public comment and questions (15 minutes)
Review upcoming flight schedules during noise sensitive hours for November 2026 – April, 2026
Update on airline use and adoption of the RNP 29Z approach procedure overlaying the Harbor Visual Approach
Review and discussion of flight discrepancy reports for June – October 2026
Closing questions, discussion, and public comment
Future agenda items requested by committee members
Setting a regular quarterly meeting date
location: Jetport conference room, second level of the terminal building, or via Zoom

1. Welcome and Introductions  
2. Opening Public Comment / Questions (15 minutes) 
3. Review Passenger, Operations, and Flight Schedule Data. 
a. Historical enplanement Data through October 2026.   
b. Review upcoming flight schedules during noise sensitive hours for November 2026 – 
April, 2026. 
 
4. Update and Report on the Required Navigation Performance RNP 29Z Approach Procedure 
Use and Adoption by Airlines: Committee will review the use to date of the new procedure that 
overlays the Harbor Visual Approach (HVA), which was published by the FAA on April 16, 
2026; but not available for PWM ATC assignment for use until June 26, 2026.    
5. Review and discussion of the flight discrepancy reports for June – October 2026:  Reports are 
posted on the Portland Jetport website at:  https://portlandjetport.org/noise-abatement-
program Scroll down to the section heading “Link To Noncompliance Report Packages”. 
6. Closing Questions/ Discussion / Public Comment 
7. Future Agenda Items:  Committee members may request future agenda items. 
8. Next Meeting:  Committee members will discuss setting a regular quarterly meeting date. 
9. Adjournment
